The follower isolates CL, has its bulk tied to its source, and lifts vout to about 1.35 V. Budget: Iref 5 uA, bias branch 2 uA, core 14 uA, follower 7 uA, about 28 uA or 50 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "Rf":    (480e3, 420e3, 700e3),
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.6),
    "I1":    (14e-6, 8e-6, 18e-6),
    "Isf":   (7e-6, 3e-6, 9e-6),
    "gmsf":  (14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Lsf":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd, cl = spec["cpd"], spec["cl"]
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    ib2 = 2e-6
    Rf, I1, Isf, Lp = p["Rf"], p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Lp"]
    gmid_p = 10.0

    # core
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    m2 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lp, I1, vds=1.3)              # load current source
    # follower (bulk = source -> vsb 0)
    msf = lut.size("p", p["gmsf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=1.3)
    m5 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lp, Isf, vds=0.45)            # follower current source
    # bias
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, ib2, vds=0.9)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, Lp, ib2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MB3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mb3)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "x", Rf)
    n.dev("M5", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("MSF", "vss", "x", "vout", "vout", msf)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, go = m1.gm, m1.gds + m2.gds
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    Cf = m1.cgd
    Cin = cpd + max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    asf = msf.gm / (msf.gm + msf.gds + m5.gds)
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.3 * msf.cgg
    Cl_tot = cl + m5.cdd + msf.cdd + 0.7 * msf.cgg * 0.2
    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    det = (s*Cin + G + s*Cf) * (go + G + s*Cx + s*Cf) + (G + s*Cf) * (gm1 - G - s*Cf)
    vx = -(gm1 - G - s*Cf) / det
    H = np.abs(vx * asf / (1 + s * Cl_tot / (msf.gm + msf.gds + m5.gds)))
    h0 = H[0]
    idx = np.where(H < h0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else 1e10

    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + kT4 * 0.8 * m2.gm / (gm1 * Rf) ** 2 \
        + kT4 * 0.8 / gm1 * (2 * PI * 1e6 * Cin) ** 2
    power = 1.8 * (iref + ib2 + I1 + Isf)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs + msf.vgs

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(h0), "f3db": f3, "power": power,
               "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2), "vout_dc": vout_dc}
